messages: Maria (docs): Heads-up: we're about to do a big rename: /api/ -> /runtime/. I split into 3 PRs: #4810 moves files+snippets, #4811 adds redirects & alias anchors, #4812 tiny migration notes. Need sequence + reviewers. Kevin (eng): I think redirects first to avoid 404s. But anchors changed in a few pages (sdk-snippets.md). We should add alias anchors in the moved pages so internal links don't break. Samir (content): yep, I marked the changed anchors in #4810 with TODOs. I can add duplicate anchors like in the new file to preserve jumps. Alex (platform): Netlify previews are isolated; production redirect rules only apply after merge. Safe order: 1) merge #4811 (redirects + alias anchors) 2) wait for prod build 3) merge #4810 (moves). That avoids live link churn. Lina (QA): +1. Please add a checklist to each PR: run link-check, run anchor-smoke, verify sample snippets execute (curl/ts). I can run the scripts after merges. Maria (docs): planned redirect snippet (_redirects.yml): ``` - from: "/api/sdk-snippets#create-client" to: "/runtime/sdk-snippets#create-client" status: 302 preserve_query: true ``` Using 302 for canary, switch to 301 later. Kevin (eng): agree on 302 first. Also please mark #4810 as "do not squash" to keep file history for moved files. Alex (platform): enabling incremental build for these PRs to speed previews. Previews: #4811 -> https://deploy-preview-4811--docs.redwood-inference.com, #4810 -> https://deploy-preview-4810--docs.redwood-inference.com. docs-ci-bot: preview build times improved. docs-ci-bot: build status #4811 preview: SUCCESS (link-check: passed) Samir (content): small snag: /guides/migrations.md references /api/auth#token-flow. I'll add a short note linking both old and new anchors for 30d in #4812. Maria (docs): updated plan: merge #4811, then #4812 (optional), then #4810. Lina will run checks after each merge. Target merge window: tomorrow 09:30-10:30 PT to avoid infra work. Any objections? Kevin (eng): none. I'll avoid infra pushes then. Lina (QA): will run `npm run linkcheck && ./scripts/anchor-smoke.sh` and report. Ping me on merge. Maria (docs): thanks. I'll add reviewers: Alex+Kevin on redirects, Samir+Maria on content, Lina for QA. I'll also add a short monitoring playbook in PR descriptions to watch for /api 404 spikes and an easy revert plan. :thumbsup: docs-ci-bot: last_activity: 1796003410
